title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VII
notes: The designer's seventh Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#4665). Jayaad (4) 9/11 (Radiant 18/22); Mend Projector (3), its controller's Units alone (R4665001); Overdrive Projector (3) and Overdrive Dome (4), both faces their controller's Units and Spells alone, each Dormant 2 turns (Radiant 1) (R4665002); Top Loser without Armor; Bot Loser without its Attack on a kill (R4665003); Medina Outfitter's Cry costs 1 mana next turn (R4665005); the Flaks roll 60/33/7 (R4665004); Servo Surge 5/3 (Radiant 10/6); Legacy: Glowy Jelly Bean (2), its pick costing (1) more and its Radiant face picking one card (R4665006); Glowy Jelly Bean Tradable and Flashback; Tranquility Tradable, its Radiant face replenishing 2 mana (R4665007); Back Breaker Taunt; Trila 3 7/4 (Radiant 14/8); Beam v5 5 damage (Radiant 10); Drone Core VII (6); Churnwalker Tribute 1. The changed scripts keep their v0.6.12b ones (R767000); Medina Outfitter's and Tranquility's new numbers read 0 under a definition that declares none (R2657006).

player.title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VII
balance: Jayaad costs (4) and is 9/11 (Radiant 18/22), up from (2) 2/6 (Radiant 4/12).
Mend Projector costs (3), up from (1), and heals and grows only your Units.
Overdrive Projector costs (3), up from (1); both faces give Rush and Windfury to your Units and Echo to your Spells only, and it is Dormant for 2 turns (Radiant 1).
Overdrive Dome costs (4), up from (2); both faces give Charge and Windfury to your Units and Echo to your Spells only, and it is Dormant for 2 turns (Radiant 1, down from 2).
Top Loser no longer has Armor.
Bot Loser no longer gains Attack when it destroys a Unit.
Medina Outfitter's Cry also makes you have 1 less mana next turn.
Flak v3, v4 and v5 deal 3 damage less often: 7% of rolls, down from 10%.
Legacy: Glowy Jelly Bean costs (2), down from (3); the card it makes Radiant costs (1) more, and its Radiant face makes one card Radiant, with no extra cost.
Glowy Jelly Bean is Tradable and has Flashback.
Tranquility is Tradable, and its Radiant face replenishes 2 mana.
Beam v5 deals 5 damage (Radiant 10), down from 6 (Radiant 12).
Drone Core VII costs (6), up from (5).
